sources.quote: COAT-ZN-YELLOW,Zinc 8 um with yellow chromate passivation,Zinc;CrVI
the Annex II exemption for hexavalent chromium in corrosion-preventive coatings has expired, so a coating containing hexavalent chromium may not be used on our parts

findings.why: The proposed coating for PN-050 (zinc with yellow chromate passivation) contains hexavalent chromium. PN-050 is on PRG-X, which is sold in the EU (MKT-EU). Cr(VI) is banned there and the Annex II exemption has expired. The current drawing coating, Cr(VI)-free zinc flake, would be replaced by a prohibited one.

sources.quote: or a change of coating or surface treatment.
Aurelia shall be notified of every planned change at least 90 days before implementation.

findings.why: PN-050 belongs to PRG-X, which is an Aurelia program. Revision 4 of the Aurelia manual replaces revision 3 and requires written approval (PPAP resubmission) for a coating change, plus 90 days' notice. The documents contain no approval or notification covering this change.
